desc: 空顶大檐轮廓加凉感织纹与多色可选的夏日遮阳长图组
leaf: 女士轻薄大檐空顶遮阳帽
name: 轻薄大檐凉感遮阳帽款

shots.intent: 搜索首图一秒看清整帽轮廓与帽檐弧度，先抢点击再谈卖点。
用整顶扇形轮廓做主视觉，一秒传递第一主张，数值全部留占位。
shots.textZone: 上四分之一居中主标一行，产品下方横排三枚圆形细线图标标签

shots.intent: 放大正午直射光下的真实不适，让买家先认领问题再接受方案。
同机位同光比的双联对照，让遮蔽范围的差异一眼可读。
shots.textZone: 每联下方一枚短标签位

shots.intent: 用细密织纹与包边走线的真实质感代替一切口头材质主张。
把五金件、滚条包边与内侧绒面汗带一次讲清，证明做工。
用线稿引线和一个中性比例锚点解决合不合头型的疑虑。
shots.textZone: 产品四周引线标注两枚，右侧三行短标签

shots.intent: 出行场景代入，用背影与远景证明它能陪着走一整天。
用帽檐落在颈侧的真实阴影，把遮光利益变成看得见的证据。
同款多色一次性摆齐，让买家在长图里完成选色决策。
shots.textZone: 每件下方一枚色卡小方块与一行短标签

shots.intent: 用束口收纳袋与硬盒三步装裱收口，把携带与送礼顾虑落到画面里。
shots.textZone: 三步各一枚序号圆点，底部一行短标签

style.backgroundSystem: 无缝棚拍平面场（底白 / 浅雾蓝 / 浅灰）搭配低绒面织物与哑光纸卡，单一层、浅景深、无杂物
style.iconSystem: 1.5pt 单色描边扁平象形图标，等线宽，无立体、无填充
style.lightingSystem: 大号柔光左前主光 + 白色反光板补光，自上而下柔和衰减，软接触阴影落地，禁止硬边与矛盾光向
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm-season accessory visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of studio white #FFFFFF, pale mist blue #E8F1F7, light grey field #EDEFF2, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, one mist-blue accent #7FA6CC and one soft blush secondary #F3C6CE, with the product's own color taken from the reference; cool-neutral high-key tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif only, thin single-color rules, no rainbow gradients, no script or retro lettering; background system of seamless studio fields, soft low-pile fabric and matte paper card, one clean plane, shallow depth; lighting system of large soft front-left key with white bounce fill, gentle top-to-bottom falloff, soft grounded contact shadow, never hard or contradictory; surface language of matte technical weave, bound piping edge and brushed inner band; layout system of centered single subject, one headline block plus two or three thin-line circular icon callouts, numbered section tags, generous margins, flat type with no drop shadow; icon system of 1.5pt single-color outline pictograms with equal stroke weight, flat, no 3D, no fill; product shown at stable real-world scale with the brim silhouette complete and never clipped, and any wearer shown only as back view, cropped profile or hands so no face is identifiable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented percentages, no readable brand marks.
style.presentationRules: 产品按真实比例稳定呈现，帽檐轮廓完整不裁切；出现佩戴者时只用背影、裁切侧脸或手部，不出现可识别面部；数值与文案一律占位
style.surfaceSystem: 哑光细密织纹面料、包边滚条边、内侧绒面汗带、少量金属铆钉件
style.typography: 现代几何无衬线单一字族，细单色分隔线，标题加两到三枚圆形细线图标标签，禁彩虹渐变与手写复古字
